summary: Server event: an entity left its party group (seen on party split and in the DEN_HarpyMeal_CharmedVictim scene where a charmed companion walks off). Created by the party data system (esv::party::DataSystem::Update / ProcessRecipeRequests on macOS); read by esv::StoryCharacterEventManager (Osiris events).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2BC5200 (add helper, 0x18 bytes) sets +0 to the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000; bg3.exe+0x2BC2690 stores *local_40 (an entity handle) there; live entity handles

fields.name: Group
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2BC2690 copies a 16-byte id (param_5, written only when non-zero) to +8/+0x10 - the old party group's Guid (cf. EntityTransferData.Group in SE Party.h); live: the same 16 bytes in all 3 instances
